event: Vermont Green FC defeated Laredo Heat SC 7-1 in the USL League Two National Semifinal, with Ryan Zellefrow scoring a hat-trick and adding an assist.
Laredo Heat SC eliminated from USL League Two playoffs via 1-7 National Semifinal loss to Vermont Green FC at PEG Energy Stadium.
Flint City Bucks defeated Ventura County Fusion 1-0 in the USL League Two National Semifinal; Oliver Moller-Jensen scored the decisive goal to send Flint to their seventh League Two Final.
Ventura County Fusion eliminated from USL League Two playoffs via 0-1 National Semifinal loss to Flint City Bucks at Atwood Stadium.
Vermont Green FC announced a public send-off event at training ahead of the August 1 USL League Two Final in Flint, MI.
Flint City Bucks confirmed as hosts of the 2026 USL League Two Final at Atwood Stadium on August 1 vs. Vermont Green FC; a fifth title would extend their all-time record.
Flint City Bucks defeated Peoria City 4-0 in the Central Conference Final to advance to the National Semifinal.
Vermont Green FC defeated Asheville City SC in the Eastern Conference Final, with head coach Chris Taylor extending his personal unbeaten record as manager to 41 matches.
Athletic Club Boise leads USL League One in total attendance with 43,248 across home matches, averaging 7,208 per game — the highest in the division.
Fort Wayne FC hold the longest active unbeaten run in USL League One at 7 games, a strong return in their first professional season.
Corpus Christi FC remain winless through 10 League One matches in their inaugural professional season — the longest active winless run in the division.
Fort Wayne FC opened Fort Wayne FC Park, a new soccer-specific stadium, as part of their debut professional season in USL League One.
2025 USL League One Young Player of the Year Mark Bronnik was transferred from One Knoxville SC upward to Tacoma Defiance in MLS NEXT Pro.
Louisville City FC lead the USL Championship Eastern Conference with 16 points from 7 matches, ahead of Tampa Bay Rowdies on 14 points.
Tampa Bay Rowdies sit second in the USL Championship Eastern Conference with 14 points from 6 matches and an unbeaten record.
Brooklyn FC sit 10th in the USL Championship Eastern Conference with 7 points from 7 matches in their inaugural professional season.
